name: Diffraction-Engineered Holography (DEH)
definition: A hologram synthesis method that requires a number of varifocal images and an optimization procedure to synthesize an optimal wave field, resulting in clear defocus blur and correct depth perception.
summary: Diffraction-Engineered Holography is a synthesis method that optimizes wave fields to reconstruct sharp images at object planes and realistic defocus blur elsewhere, distinguishing itself by explicitly enhancing out-of-focus blur.
